source: AWS Price List API, service AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, feature On-demand Inference, all Regions
note: Keyed by the model id without its inference profile prefix. A global. profile uses the global rate. A geographic profile (us., eu., apac., au., jp.) is priced like its source Region, and a bare model id is the in-Region rate; on 2026-10-21 the Price List gave the same in-Region rate in every commercial Region that lists one (GovCloud is higher and is not covered), so one regional rate serves all of them. cache_read and cache_write are the Bedrock prompt-cache rates (5-minute cache writes). Haiku 4.5 is not a default model; it is kept so a -c orchestratorModel or specialistModel override is still priced. Token cost only; AgentCore Runtime, Browser, Gateway and Lambda are not included.
